d: JP Legal is a forward-thinking law firm providing corporate, commercial, and advisory legal services to local and international clients. We combine strong legal expertise with a commercial approach and a growing focus on legal innovation and technology.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Litigation Lawyer to join our legal team in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for handling litigation matters before Saudi courts and judicial committees, providing legal advice, drafting pleadings, and representing clients across various types of disputes in compliance with Saudi laws and regulations.
Represent clients before Saudi courts and judicial bodies, including:
Draft, review, and submit legal pleadings, statements of claim, defenses, appeals, and legal memoranda.
Attend hearings, court sessions, and meetings with judges, notaries, and government authorities.
Manage litigation files from initiation through resolution, including enforcement proceedings.
Conduct legal research and provide opinions in accordance with Saudi laws, regulations, and judicial precedents.
Advise clients on litigation strategies, risk assessment, and dispute resolution options.
Coordinate with clients, experts, and internal teams to gather evidence and prepare cases.
Monitor changes in Saudi laws, regulations, and court practices relevant to litigation.
Ensure compliance with Saudi legal and procedural requirements, including Najiz and other judicial platforms.
Bachelor’s degree in Law (LL.B); Master’s degree is a plus.
Licensed to practice law in Saudi Arabia (Saudi Bar Association license preferred or required).
Minimum 7 years of litigation experience in Saudi Arabia.
Strong knowledge of Saudi laws and procedures, including:
Sharia principles as applied by Saudi courts
Experience handling cases through Najiz and other Saudi judicial electronic systems.
Excellent legal drafting and advocacy skills in Arabic (mandatory); English proficiency is a strong advantage.
Strong analytical, organizational, and case management skills.

The Logistics Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and controlling all logistics activities for HV/EHV Underground Cable (UGC) projects, ensuring the timely and safe movement, storage, handling, and delivery of cables, equipment, materials, and project resources to and from project sites.

The role requires close coordination with Project Management, Procurement, Warehouse, Engineering, Construction, HSE, QA/QC, suppliers, transporters, and client representatives to ensure uninterrupted project execution and compliance with project requirements.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 7–10 years of relevant experience in logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
Experience in Saudi Arabia and familiarity with local transportation, logistics, and regulatory requirements.
Experience in project-based environments, particularly large-scale construction and infrastructure projects.
Experience handling heavy, high-value, and sensitive materials and equipment.
Experience coordinating logistics operations, transportation, warehousing, material handling, and delivery activities for large-scale projects.
Direct experience in HV/EHV Underground Cable (UGC) projects, cable drum transportation/handling, and Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) projects.
Candidates with experience in the following sectors
HV/EHV Underground Cables | Power Transmission | SEC Projects | EPC | Electrical Infrastructure | Utilities | Construction & Contracting | Substations | Transmission Networks

d: We’re currently looking for Editors in the Earth and Environmental Science team on a work-from-home basis. This would be a contractual agreement, and renewable upon mutual consent. Work will be available regularly so that you can maintain a predictable schedule.
q: A Master's or PhD degree in one or more specialized subject areas listed below
Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate scientific content and ensure discipline-specific accuracy.
Excellent written English and attention to detail.
Prior experience in scientific editing, peer review, or academic publishing would be an advantage.

Environmental Science | Atmospheric Science | Geology | Mineralogy | Climate Science | Geophysics | Energy | Renewable Energy | Sustainability | Sustainable Development | Waste Management | Energy Conservation | Hydrology | Meteorology | Oceanography | Space and Planetary Science | Volcanology | Weather Studies | Climate Change | Climate Science | Marine Science
